text: hm. well now im colliding with it, so that is good. keep the log around, but were back to i cant go under the thing, its an invisible wall under the sign again.
resolution: Superseded by req_1606 and folded into it. req_1603 reported the sign's walk-under regressing again (invisible wall under the beam) after the parallel prop-collision refactor landed. Before isolating that specific case, the user re-tested and found broader collision regressions (stairs block, flowers block, can't walk under floors/roofs) plus asked to push the diagnostic further. Confirmed nothing in the COMMITTED compiled-collision path changed since my req_1587 walk-under worked (only an inert log commit + an unrelated text-tool commit), so the regressions originate in the half-finished refactor in the dirty working tree (bakeGameFile.ts etc.), which is why symptoms shift each rebuild. Delivered the RJIT_COLLIDERLOG per-collider detail dump (commit 668f0c4a5) to surface the actual baked bands/solid flags at runtime regardless of the churn; awaiting the user's log output to fix each mis-baked collider at the source. No separate code change under this id.
